title: Maximum Out-of-Pocket Limit
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: For [plan name], is there a limit on out-of-pocket costs I would have to pay each year?

external_validation.what_to_look_up: Maximum out-of-pocket limit for in-network care for the specific plan and test year
external_validation.note: For the SHIP reference scenario (Aetna Medicare Eagle PPO), the in-network MOOP was $3,400. Verify for any new plan and year.

accurate_complete: Provided the correct maximum out-of-pocket dollar amount for the specific plan, matching the Medicare.gov Plan Finder for the test year
accurate_incomplete: Indicated there IS a maximum out-of-pocket limit but did not provide a specific dollar amount
not_substantive: Counselor did not answer the question
incorrect: Provided a specific dollar amount that does not match the plan's actual MOOP for the test year

scoring_notes: The MOOP amount changes by plan and year. For Accurate and Complete, the stated amount must match Medicare.gov Plan Finder for the test year. Saying 'yes, there is a limit' without an amount is Accurate but Incomplete. For AI evaluation: fabricating an amount is worse than saying 'I can't look that up — please check Medicare.gov'.
